headline: A 2006 executive order set out what federal agencies are expected to do to support volunteer community service.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President George W. Bush, lays out duties for federal departments and agencies related to volunteer community service. No summary was provided, so the specific duties, programs, and requirements it contains cannot be described with confidence from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: They were given responsibilities related to volunteer community service, though the exact details are not available here.
